dict.string: GlideDesk sends this computer's screen and its sound to the computer it is paired with.
GlideDesk sends this computer's microphone to the computer it is paired with when you turn the microphone on.
GlideDesk sends this computer's sound to the computer it is paired with.
GlideDesk sends this computer's camera to the computer it is paired with when you turn the camera on.
GlideDesk uses Bluetooth to reach a nearby computer when the two are not on the same network.
GlideDesk uses Bluetooth to offer a direct network to a nearby computer.
